examples.against: Fasting-day check: 418 kcal counts as a fasting day for anyone whose estimated need is 1672 kcal or more. One serving as the day's single meal, the form the Chicago alternate-day trials used (one provided meal of 400-600 kcal eaten between 12 and 2 pm, formulated at 30% fat, 15% protein, 55% carbohydrate): this recipe is fat 23.7%, protein 20.1%, carbohydrate 60.3% of energy, fibre 13.0 g, sodium 455 mg. Rule used: of the carried recipes with 400-600 kcal a serving and consistent values (cold fusilli 418, chicken angel hair pasta 452, turkey bolognese 463; mushroom penne 418 is left out because its fat, carbohydrate and protein add up to only 55% of its stated kcal), the one closest to 30/15/55.
